notes: The owner: the UX "would feel more like Microsoft Teams with nouns and verbs that users of such systems now expect… that fact that XMPP is being used shouldn't even be obvious." The rail now reads Chats (people by name, presence dots, every recorded 1:1), Channels (published names, a "+ Join or create…" row), and Accounts — the per-protocol plumbing tucked away. Conversation titles are names with the address in the tooltip; the Accounts panel says People, Channels, Add someone; no protocol word or XEP number headlines anything. Marked accounts auto-connect at daemon boot, because seamless mean
